newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers offered higher, buyers sidelined.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers offered higher, buyers sidelined.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were firmer on Monday on crude gains and traders' perception of rising cargo prices, traders said on Monday.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $105-$106 and 380-cst at $98-$99, around $2-$3 frimer from Friday's quotes. MDO and gasoil were little changed at around $200 and $216/$218 respectively.

Traders said the bunker market remained quiet with most shipowners at the sidelines waiting for prices to come off. One seller said offers are likely to ease later Monday if enquiries continue to be thin. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3082)
